title: Playing DnD in the game shop...
content: This happened ages ago, but recently, it's been plaguing my mind. There were six of us, total, meeting once every two weeks. I was a white furred Tabaxi artificer specializing in potions. We used my wagon to get around. My party were a dwarf cleric using a war deity, a human ranger/druid, a half orc barbarian, and a raven aarakocra bard, who had a few levels in monk, due to backstory. He was missing one wing. The game had clearly been going on a while, and while I went back only every so often, I always remembered the previous sessions, even if I hadn't dreamed them. We did, eventually, wrap up our story, taking down the lich before he could ascend to it. I don't know why it's bugging me so much. It almost feels like my party is still waiting on me, suddenly...
